# Titre du chapitre

This `# Titre du chapitre` heading is doing two jobs at once:

- In the **book**, it's this file's chapter title (shown in the sidebar).
- In a **slide deck**, when this file is pulled in via `{{< include >}}`,
  it becomes reveal.js's top-level horizontal section — so keep exactly
  one `# H1` per chapter file, at the very top.

Every `##` becomes a vertical sub-section of slides; every `###` becomes
its own slide title within that. Write chapter content the same way
whether it'll only ever appear in the book, only in slides, or both —
there's nothing format-specific to add here.

## A sub-topic

### A slide-sized point

Bullet points, images, callouts — all normal Quarto markdown works here
and renders sensibly in both the book and the deck.
